preview:
Sarah: I get it, Rob. This has been a lot of back and forth, and I'm sorry for that.

Just so I don't get it wrong: do you mean you'd rather keep the KBOX and give it

messages.text: I would like to exchange it for my kd miner

Happy to help with that. Just so I've got it right, you'd like to switch your KBOX order over to the Harlo B30?

What's the order number, and the name or postcode ····to? Once I've pulled it up I'll check the price difference and tell you exactly when the B30 would ship.
Yes, Im Robin L. with the bad KD BOX
Used the store-orders skill

Thanks, Robin. Sorry the KBOX has been giving you trouble.

To pull your order up I need two things: the order number (it looks like Shop····) and the email you used at checkout. Once I have them I can see what's on the order and go through the B30 switch with you properly.
(email hidden) The KD BOX is boxed & ready to ship to you
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Replacement already given and shipped; switching to a B30 is outside my rules an

I found it, Rob. I'm sorry this has dragged on: the KBOX arrived October 29, you reported it on November 4, and the replacement was only approved today.

That replacement is two Thor P2s on order Shop····. They already shipped today and arrive by November 15. Switching to a B30 instead isn't something I can approve myself, so I've passed your request to the team. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you with an answer.

Either way, please send the KBOX back with the UPS label you have and write Shop···· on the box.
Ok, the price for the KDBOX Ill pay the difference to get the B30,

Got it, Rob. You'd pay the difference to get a B30 instead. I've added that to your request. Just so you know, the B30 is a pre-order and ships by November 30.

The team will want to know one thing: the two Thor P2s are already on their way to you. If they agree to the B30, would you send both P2s back unopened when they arrive? Once I have your answer, the team has everything they need to decide and give you the exact amount.
of course Ill send the Thors back unopened. One more time, I would like the B30 in exchange for the KD BOX. Thank you, I hope we can work together.
Handed to the team · Customer's request is now complete: he will pay the difference and return both T

I've sent your request to the team, Rob: you want the B30 in exchange for the KBOX, you'll pay the difference, and you'll send both Thor P2s back unopened when they arrive. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email with their decision and the exact amount.

In the meantime, please go ahead and send the KBOX back with your UPS label, with Shop···· written on the box. Thanks for being so patient with us. A copy of this chat will come to your email too.
no address?

The address is already printed on the prepaid UPS label we emailed you today (tracking ····). Just tape that label onto the box, write Shop···· on the outside, and drop it at any UPS location.

For reference, it goes to our warehouse:
ShipBob, Inc. [ATTN: Returns]
(address hidden)
Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden)

If you can't find that email, check your spam folder. Tell me if it's not there.
Ok Ill be sending it back tomorrow

Sounds good, Rob. Once UPS scans it, you can follow it on the same tracking number. Your B30 request is with the team, and they'll email you with their decision and the exact difference. Until you hear back, keep the Thor P2s sealed when they arrive.
I see you dont sell the KDBOX, why?

The maker, GekkoScience, has no KBOX units left to supply us, so we can't get more in. That's also why your replacement couldn't be another KBOX.

The B30 is a good step up from it. It's 30 TH/s at about 405 W at the wall, compared with the KBOX's 22 TH/s at 330 W. The team has your request to switch to it.
I would like to have my money back for the KDBOX. Shipping out today. Please cancel Goldshell 24th order. Thank you,
Used the store-orders skill

Understood, Rob. Before anything moves, one thing to check: we've never sold Goldshell, and I don't see a Goldshell order on your account. Do you mean the Magic M. 40T order you placed with us on October 23 (Shop····, ships December 7)? Or is it an order with another store?

On the KBOX: you've already had two Thor P2s as its replacement. An option that keeps every dollar is store credit for what you paid for the KBOX, applied once it reaches our warehouse. You could use it on the B30 or anything in stock. Would that work for you?
ok, lets just do 2 - 40T Units
Read the magic miner 40t page
Searched the catalog · Magic M. 40T

Happy to look at that, Rob. One quick check so I pass the right thing on: you already have one Magic M. 40T on order (Shop····, ships December 7). Do you mean one more 40T in place of the B30, so you'd have two in total? Or two new ones on top of that?

New 40Ts are $799 each and are Batch 10 pre-orders, not in stock. Once you confirm, I'll update your request so the team can work out the exact amount with the KBOX value applied.
Yes, Id rather have the 2-40T to wrap this up.
Handed to the team · Request changed from B30 to a second 40T; needs a person to approve, price and s

Done, Rob. I've updated your request: you'd like the KBOX settled as a second Magic M. 40T, so you have two in total, and you'll send both Thor P2s back unopened. The team will review it and email you their answer, including the exact amount either way and how to send back the P2s.

Please still send the KBOX today with the UPS label and Shop···· on the box. Also, the Goldshell order on the 24th isn't one of ours, so it would need to be cancelled with whichever store you bought it from.
No no Im sorry. Id rather have the 2 40T miners in place of prior orders

No problem, Rob, let's get it exactly right. Just to confirm: you want two new 40Ts in place of the KBOX and the two Thor P2s, and you'd keep your existing 40T on Shop···· as well, so three 40Ts in total?

Or do you mean two 40Ts in total, counting the one you already have on order?
no no , Just two 40T, the one on pre-order & One for now

Got it, that's what I've passed on: two 40Ts in total, your existing pre-order plus one more in place of the KBOX.

One thing to know before the team replies. We don't have any 40Ts in stock to ship right now. The extra one would be a Batch 10 pre-order, and Batch 10 ships December 21, 2026. Your current one on Shop···· ships December 7.

If that works for you, nothing else is needed from you. The team will email you their answer and the exact amount.
batch 10 is ok.

Perfect, Rob. I've noted that Batch 10 works for you. Your request is complete now: two 40Ts in total, the KBOX goes back today with Shop···· on the box, and the Thor P2s go back unopened when they arrive. The team will email you their answer, the exact amount, and how to return the P2s.

Thanks for sticking with us through all of this.
Just the 2-40th Magic M. in total.

Understood, Rob. Two Magic M. 40Ts in total, and nothing else. No B30, and the Thor P2s go back to us unopened. That's exactly what the team has, and they'll email you the answer and the exact amount.
Great, Just need an RMA so everything is correct.

The KBOX already has its RMA, Rob: Shop····. Write that on the box and use the UPS label we emailed you (tracking ····).

The Thor P2s will get their own return reference and label once the team approves the switch to the second 40T. They'll send it with their answer. Until then, keep the P2s sealed when they arrive.
I have no printer. I just took a pictures. They will send it to that address? (address hidden)?

Yes, Rob, it goes to our warehouse at (address hidden), Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden). That address is already on the label.

You don't need a printer. Take the box to a UPS Store and show them the label email or your photo of it. They can usually print it for you there. Just make sure the barcode is clear, since the tracking number ···· is what links the parcel to your return. Write Shop···· on the box by hand.
I will send it there

Sounds good, Rob. Please use our prepaid UPS label rather than paying for postage yourself. It's free for you, and its tracking number links the parcel straight to your return, so we know it's yours the moment it arrives.

Once it's on its way, nothing else is needed from you. The team will email you about the two 40Ts.
Ok, I can do that. Under what Gmail Address? I've looked the past few days with no instructions. What address is it going too?
Used the order-swap skill
Handed to the team · Customer cannot find the Nov 11 return label email and has no printer; label nee

Sorry, Rob, I assumed you had that email. The label was emailed on November 11 to (email hidden) from (email hidden) Some of our emails have been landing in spam, so it's worth checking Spam and Promotions for it.

The parcel goes to our warehouse: ShipBob, Inc. [ATTN: Returns], (address hidden), Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden).

If you can't find it, don't worry. I've asked the team to resend the label to that Gmail in a form you can show at a UPS Store without a printer.
Sarahhhhh
I'm here, Rob. What's up? Did the label turn up, or is something else not right?
Was hooping it up at one of my childern to forget this entire order.

I get it, Rob. This has been a lot of back and forth, and I'm sorry for that.

Just so I don't get it wrong: do you mean you'd rather keep the KBOX and give it to one of your kids, and drop the return and the 40T switch? Or is the plan still two 40Ts in total, with the KBOX and Thor P2s coming back to us?
